<subject>RE: Urgent: Payment Due for Regional Health Network Invoice by End of Day Tuesday 27/11 - NOTICE OF AGREEMENT BREACH</subject>
<body>
Dear Bill,

It was our understanding that Lumière Santé SAS had fulfilled the Regional Health Network’s credit requirements last week; however, below is a notice indicating that the invoice remains unpaid. Please be advised that Lumière Santé’s participation in the Regional Health Network activities will be suspended if payment is not received by close of business on Tuesday, 27 November.

Kindly inform us if the Government Affairs team should contact the Regional Health Network to discuss this matter. You can reach me at extension 38012.

Best regards,  
Céline Marchand

-----Original Message-----  
From: Hartley, John  
Sent: Wednesday, 21 November 2021 09:20  
To: Marchand, Céline L.; Lefèvre, Jacques D.  
Cc: Martin, Stéphane J.; Dubois, Emilie  
Subject: FW: NOTICE OF REGIONAL HEALTH NETWORK AGREEMENT BREACH - November 20th PAYMENT OVERDUE

For your information.

-----Original Message-----  
From: finance@regionalhealthnet.fr  
Sent: Tuesday, 20 November 2021 20:43  
To: b.pitre@lumieresante.fr; j.hartley@lumieresante.fr  
Cc: l.roux@regionalhealthnet.fr; m.bernard@regionalhealthnet.fr  
Subject: NOTICE OF REGIONAL HEALTH NETWORK AGREEMENT BREACH - November 20th PAYMENT OVERDUE  
Importance: High

This is an official notice that Lumière Santé SAS is currently considered in breach of the Regional Health Network Operating Agreement due to non-payment of your invoice dated 7 November 2021 by 1:00 p.m. today. Pursuant to Section 15.1.3 of the Operating Agreement, you have until the close of business on Tuesday, 27 November 2021 to resolve this breach by remitting full payment.

Failure to do so will result in Lumière Santé SAS being declared in default, with immediate suspension from committee meetings, market transactions, and service provision within the Regional Health Network. Additionally, all members will be notified tomorrow of companies failing to meet their payment obligations for November activities.

Should you have any questions regarding this notice or the outstanding amount, please contact Marie Bernard at +33 1 44 55 66 77 or Luc Roux at +33 1 44 55 66 88.

Sincerely,  
Sophie Dupuis  
Controller  
Lumière Santé SAS  
</body>
